newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner confirms Clementi leaving for BoE. [CORRECTED 13:36 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Dresdner confirms Clementi leaving for BoE. [CORRECTED 13:36 GMT]

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG on Tuesday confirmed a newspaper report that David Clementi, the vice-chairman of Dresdner's investment bank unit Kleinwort Benson Group, was leaving the bank to join the Bank of England.
"It's not a defection, but is a move to seize an opportunity which we as a private sector bank could not have offered him," Dresdner chief executive Juergen Sarrazin told a news conference.
He said Clementi's departure was not the result of any disagreement. "(Such a departure) could have led to conclusions that there are problems in our integration (of Kleinwort Benson)," he added.

Frankfurter Allgemeine newspaper said Clementi was leaving to become the new deputy governor of the Bank of England, but Dresdner did not (corrects to make clear Dresdner did not comment on Clementi's position) say which position Clementi would take up.
